nodes.text: Friend! The road is kinder today. Grib counted seven carts and nobody threw anything at Grib. A good week!
Grib will! Numbers are honest. Not like camps. Safe travels, friend — Grib keeps this stretch of road lucky for you.
The guards squint. The merchant counts his spoons when Grib walks past. But the old one by the well shares her bread. Bramblewick is... mostly soft. Grib likes mostly soft.
